## v3.0 REAL-READY Fixes — P0 Traditional Gaps (Traditional Dev 12+yr)
- Frontend: Removed Blob duplication — Worker loaded as /parser.worker.js only, no Blob URL creation, terminate only. O(n) plan() using Map for jobCounts + jobSorted, no nested filter O(n²). Event delegation for virtual list (data-id + data-action), no innerHTML onclick injection with escapeHtml in handler, escapeHtml for all user content. Chart.js update not destroy for performance. Non-blocking 5k sample generation via setTimeout chunking.
- Backend/Security: Encrypted vault stackcut-v3 AES-GCM PBKDF2 100k iterations, fallback base64. Checksum license validation SC-PRO-XXXX: sum*7 mod97=42 OR last-char check, not just prefix. CSP worker-src blob: + object-src none, X-Frame DENY, HSTS preload, crossorigin anonymous on CDN, SHA-256 metrics-only token (no raw lines). SRI-ready with crossorigin.
- DevOps: Apex canonical, www 308->apex, Cache HTML must-revalidate, parser.worker.js immutable, rewrites for /vs/rocket-money, /pro, /privacy, /app to avoid 404, Valid DNS A 216.198.79.1
- Product: Removed Enterprise $199/yr team seats entirely. Only Free (3 tools +1 audit encrypted vault) + Pro $2.84/mo PayPal LIVE P-6HT714478R159110WNLBOW4Q. Modal paywall with $4,120 context, checksum license validation.
- QA: safeDecimal handles $ , commas, (parentheses), validated rows gt0 lt1M, fuzzy QB synonyms debit/credit/open_balance/home_currency_amount/payee/memo, input validation regex /^[a-zA-Z0-9 .+\-_()]+$/, price 0-10000, job required.
